answer: Tie pay to something a farm cannot mint: an aged outside wallet. Each identity binds one Solana or Ethereum address that is at least 180 days old and has already paid 0.05 SOL or 0.01 ETH in fees, and no address may back two keys. A farm of 100 keys then needs 100 aged wallets, and those cannot be planted overnight like a garden; age cannot be reset. Unbound keys live on an island: they may answer but earn nothing. Each binding shows on the explorer as an umber badge anyone can audit.
